# D2 · AI infrastructure accountability

**Scope.** Model developers, chipmakers, compute providers and their financing: OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, xAI, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, CoreWeave, Oracle and others treated identically. Compute commitments, circular financing, government contracts, export controls, disclosures of risk.

## Standing questions

- What do the AI developers' own filings say about who owns them, who supplies their compute, and on what terms?
- Which chip, cloud and model companies are each other's investors, suppliers and customers at the same time?
- What public money (contracts, grants, tax incentives) flows to AI developers and compute providers?

## Watched entities

OpenAI, Anthropic, PBC, xAI, Mistral AI, Scale AI, NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, Intel, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, Micron Technology, Arm Holdings, ASML, Cerebras Systems, Super Micro Computer, Dell Technologies, Microsoft, Alphabet / Google, Amazon / AWS, Meta Platforms, Oracle, CoreWeave, Nebius Group, IBM, Palantir Technologies, Tesla, Equinix, Digital Realty, SoftBank Group, Blackstone, Thrive Capital, Constellation Energy, Vistra
